quality.pairing: All 512 original PNGs match bit-for-bit across the weight and NFPA baselines. Weight candidates share original class/index/generation seed; NFPA pairs are identified by original PNG hash.
quality.interpretation: Paired pixel/perceptual distances measure sample drift. Weight-modified generators may produce different valid images even for the same class/seed; low similarity alone is not poor generation quality. CLIP class alignment is the common semantic proxy. No metric certifies factual or identity preservation.

weight_detection.selection: all predetermined candidates; no owner-score-based selection
weight_detection.scope: Fixed native generator training recipe; decoder left unchanged without consulting watermark location

nfpa_detection.access: Attack workers receive only opaque PNGs and independent public model, no target weights/decoder/detector/keys/payload/labels/prompts.
nfpa_detection.limitations: Output purification, not modifying a closed provider. Paired metrics do not certify factual/semantic identity; 256 calibration images cannot validate extreme FPRs. No FID claim.
